stance_rationale: Equity-level hard constraints and the covariance PSD/condition-number checks pass, and the available stage weights are a true 269-month schedule rather than a single snapshot. The draft still needs revision because required handoff path/schema, cost/net-IR evidence, current tail fallback, beta drift, and sequential-admission audits are missing or deferred.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: single-change WT hypothesis A/B target; not selected by optimizer-stage net_ir maximization

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Computed from stage_artifacts/WT_WT_S20260626_001/weights.csv as annualized half-L1 turnover including CASH. Turnover is 685.3% annual, below the 1100% hard cap, but the package does not report this value or a net_ir/cost-adjusted outcome.

critical_concerns.description: The required qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-S20260626_001/weights.csv is absent, and the available stage weights use Date,Ticker,weight,Name,Sector rather than as_of_date,ticker,weight,method_selected. This is not RF-O9 single-snapshot failure because 269 monthly dates exist, but it is a Forge handoff contract failure unless explicitly accepted.

The package frames selection_objective as turnover-adjusted active return but does not report turnover_annual, estimated_cost, net_ir, or regime-switch cost. Independent schedule audit gives annual turnover 6.8532 and estimated round-trip 15bps cost 0.02056, so the omission is material even though the hard turnover cap passes.

Expected TE 5.12% is based on a single best-overlap representative month. The inherited 18-name covariance overlaps the 269-month weight schedule poorly: mean overlap is 1.75 names, 264/269 dates have overlap below 10, and current 2026-06 overlap is 4/18. This makes the TE claim fragile as optimizer evidence.

CRISIS handling is not explicit: overlay schedule has only 3 CRISIS months, max-cash is less defensive in co-firing months, and no crisis-specific max_w shrink, cash floor, or current A/B CVaR/MDD check is supplied before Forge.

Beta drift and sequential admission are missing: no beta_port versus benchmark target, no overlay-OFF versus blended beta report, no TDC versus PG2/MEGA_05 value, and no replacement/integration scenario.

No optimizer_challenge_note.md or optimizer infeasibility/open-question note exists yet. Since this is a draft, that is expected timing-wise, but finalization needs a No Silent Override response to these optimizer-specific concerns.

supporting_arguments: Available stage weights are monthly from 2004-02-01 to 2026-06-01 with 20 equity names plus CASH per date; equity max weight is 0.20, min weight is 0, and no equity weight is negative.
Including CASH, max absolute sum deviation from 1.0 is 9.83e-09.

Covariance artifacts under stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260626_001 and stage_artifacts/WT_WT_S20260626_001 are 18x18, symmetric, PSD, Ledoit-Wolf, min eigenvalue about 0.000157, condition number 40.9539, satisfying the post-shrink condition-number check.
The schedule is not single-snapshot: overlay_combine_schedule.csv has 269 rows, 32 AR/R05 co-firing divergence months, and mean cash reduction of 10.66pp in divergence months.
Hill alpha is 2.2537 in the inherited risk package, so RF-O12 heavy-tail MVO dependence is not triggered, and the package is not using MVO/HRP/CVaR/ERC weight search.
